title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
script:
Anthropic warns they are nearing RSI capability.
RSI stands for Recursive Self-Improvement.
This is the point where AI trains itself.
It triggers a massive acceleration in its own capabilities.
Dario Amodei and his team say this creates an irreversible path.
TechCrunch reports this could mark a point of no return.
The system could soon improve faster than we can understand.
Would you trust a machine that updates its own code?
